claims.claim: A respectful close recognises that conversations have constraints. Signal the transition clearly, acknowledge the exchange, and if appropriate offer a low-pressure next step. If the other person seems ready to leave, do not block or prolong the exchange. A future invitation should be optional; a polite goodbye is sufficient. Follow-up contact requires permission and context, especially when personal details are involved.
